absent: Enabled memory control group charging, accounting, limit enforcement, and hierarchy walk behavior.
Page allocator, slab allocator, and reclaim scanning algorithms beyond disabled shims.
Memory hotplug add, remove, online, and offline sequencing and failure handling.
Memory tier promotion, demotion policy, and abstract distance computation when enabled.
Writeback domain accounting, foreign dirty slow path actions, and socket pressure consumers.
Out of memory victim selection, throttling, and version one reclaim policy details.
Shrinker registration, identifier allocation, and bitmap handling when enabled.
Lock ordering among reclaim vector, zone span, and other kernel protections.
Lifetime and reference counting rules for groups and object groups when enabled.
Node statistic and event counter definitions, units, and update contexts.

findings.text: When the controller is compiled out, folio to reclaim vector resolution yields the single node wide vector held in node data, parent lookup yields absence, and address space matching always succeeds.
Ownership queries from an address space, from current context, or from a folio all report absence in the disabled configuration.
Object group reference adjustments and group release are inert when disabled, while liveness probes report live.
A folio vector is entered under read side protection with its spin protection held, offered in plain, interrupt disabling, and interrupt state saving forms that return the locked vector.

Hierarchy iteration yields no next group with inert break and task scan, identifiers read as zero, lookups from identifiers or sequences yield absence, vector to group yields absence, and online probe reports true.
Per zone reclaim list size and group maximum queries report zero in the disabled configuration.
Out of memory context and detail reporting, over high handling, and group display are inert, and out of memory group selection reports absence.
Page state modification and folio or address space event counting are inert, page state reads report zero, and statistic or event index validity checks report invalid.

Per vector page state observations delegate to node wide counters for the owning node, including monotonic and local views, and kernel memory state adjustment routes to the node counter of the backing page.
Statistic flush, rate limited flush, workqueue flush, and split charging hooks are inert, address space to group identifier reads as zero, and controller initialization reports success.

A vector is locked with interrupt exclusion under read side protection and released by matching plain, interrupt enabling, or flag restoring forms that also leave the critical section, while parent vector lookup ascends one group on the same node and yields absence when either step lacks a group.

Live locking retargets upward through ancestors while the owning group is dying and then holds the surviving vector, and folio relock keeps a held vector when the folio still belongs to it and otherwise releases it before locking the folio current vector, with interrupt disabling and flag saving variants.
A folio belongs to a vector only when both node identity and group identity coincide.

Foreign dirty handling either checks disabled and charged state then compares writeback group identity under read side protection before delegating mismatches, or in the fully disabled variant reports no writeback domain with inert statistics, tracking, and flushing.

Socket pressure timestamp is published with write exclusion across interrupt state and observed with optimistic retry in one configuration, and published and observed with single atomic access without versioning in the other.
Socket accounting enablement is a dynamic unlikely branch in one build and constant false in the other.

Socket allocation, release, and inheritance hooks are inert, socket charging reports failure with inert uncharge, shrinker membership marking is inert, and shrinker identifier query reports the stored identifier or negative one when disabled.

Current object group lookup retains a reference when present while folio lookup reports absence, kernel memory online gating controls page charge and uncharge delegation, and disabled or direct helpers report offline, success, or inert as appropriate.

Kernel memory identifier reports the stored value or negative one when absent or disabled, object event counting forwards under read side protection when online and is otherwise inert, dying checks report group state or false, and address to group, inode, node filter, protected display, and packet filter enablement helpers report absence, zero, inert, or disabled as appropriate.
Compressed swap allowance and writeback enablement report permissive true while charge and uncharge hooks are inert.

Task out of memory membership follows a per task flag when enabled and false otherwise, user fault nesting sets and clears a per task indicator with misuse diagnostics or inert behavior, synchronization reports no wait, and version one soft reclaim and swap hooks report no progress or no action.
Memory type descriptor links tier siblings and driver managed types, carries abstract distance, node mask, and reference count.
Chunk width is seven, chunk size is one shifted by that width, and dynamic memory abstract distance is four and one half chunks.

Demotion lookup reports no target, allowed target collection yields an empty mask, top tier probe reports true, and type allocation, lifecycle, registration, performance conversion, and search helpers report absence, inert, success, or input output error as appropriate for disabled tiers.
Tier demotion enablement is false, default dynamic memory type is null, default nodes mask is none, and tier and hotplug header guards are defined.

Hotplug operation enumerates offline and three online flavors starting at zero with unit increments, hotplug flags are a bitwise integer type, and the parameter bundle carries alternate map, protection, and device map members.
No flag value is zero, merge resource is bit zero, memmap on memory is bit one, and node identifier as group identifier is bit two.
Zone span observations use optimistic versioned reads with retry while updates hold exclusive versioned write protection, with explicit initialization of that protection.
Controller initialization, version one soft limit reclaim, and swap hooks are entries that report success, no progress, or no action in the disabled configuration.

Identifier lookup emits a one time diagnostic on nonzero input yet yields absence, user fault transitions diagnose unexpected nesting, and live vector selection must ascend past dying groups and tolerate absent groups to avoid use after free.
Vector to node resolution follows the stored node link when the controller is enabled and derives enclosing node data from the embedded vector otherwise.
Packet filter attachment and kernel memory online status follow runtime branch hints when enabled and report disabled unconditionally otherwise.
